verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 that gives programmatic access to all compute resources, plus a GraphQL API for Pods, templates and Serverless endpoints with cURL examples. It also offers an S3-compatible storage API and Serverless SDKs for Python, JavaScript and Go, and its official MCP server is built on the REST API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
